title: Mini online shop for a handmade candle brand
lead: A catalogue with filters and sorting, a cart with an automatic discount, and an order form.
problem: A small brand of handmade candles needs a mini shop: a catalogue, a product page and a cart with an order form.
built: A catalogue with filters by type (glass, wax, sets) and sorting by price.
A product page with a scent choice and a quantity.
A cart where quantity can be changed and items removed, with the total always visible; the cart is remembered in the browser.
A 10% discount that is calculated automatically from a set order total.
An order form (name, phone, address, comment) and a choice of delivery service.
steps: Browse the catalogue and filter by type.
Open a product and pick a scent and a quantity.
The cart updates the total and applies the discount.
Fill in the order form and choose a delivery option.
offer: A mini shop built around your products and photos.
Orders arrive in your Telegram or email.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
